Produces light through a chemical reaction. Stalkers widely use chemical light sources as independent lighting in emergencies and wherever other lighting is unavailable. Self-sufficient, durable, fireproof, waterproof and suitable for long-term storage, they are useful in many situations. 
This variant emits cyan light. Its range is much shorter than average, but it provides the brightest illumination possible. Ideal underground or in daylight for lighting hard-to-see corners.

Brain Scorcher and Miracle Machine flickering
Lamps and flashlights flicker in the Brain Scorcher and Miracle Machine as long as they are active to give a reason to bring glowsticks.
Chance to find glowsticks on dead bodies.
When enabled, player will use glowsticks with lower condition first, and will keep unused glowsticks for later.
Chance to find glowsticks in stashes.
Key to hold to throw glowsticks.
